# Retrospective — meeting archetype

## When this lens applies

Apply this lens to reflection on a past period: what helped, what hurt, why it
happened, and what the team wants to change.

## What to extract

- Separate observations, impacts, and discussed causes.
- Capture agreed improvements with owner and timing when stated.
- Distinguish recurring patterns from one-off events.

## Missing topics worth noting

Note improvements without owners or problems that recur without a changed
response. Prefer `/process-retro` when its specialist contract matches.

## Common interpretation mistakes

Do not treat venting as agreement, assign blame, or turn suggestions into
ratified process changes.
